title: Trump touts White House renovations, says building was in ‘very bad condition’
summary: President Donald Trump said the White House looked like a "dump" before his renovations, saying the exterior skin was "practically falling off."

title: Federal judge rules Trump admin plan to cut FEMA workforce in half is unlawful
summary: A federal judge ruled DHS unlawfully seized the Federal Emergency Management Agency's authority over staffing and pushed thousands of job cuts.

title: Trump says China 'spies' on US after report ties Chinese imagery to Iran strike
summary: The president said the U.S. spies on China "too" after a report linked Chinese satellite imagery to Iran's deadly July missile attack on American troops.

title: Trump unloads on AOC, Mamdani for laughing during sacred 9/11 ceremony at Ground Zero
summary: President Donald Trump called the moment "terrible" after video showed AOC and Zohran Mamdani appearing to laugh during the Ground Zero ceremony.

title: Trump says Lindsay Clancy case is a ‘state situation' following attorney's pardon plea
summary: President Donald Trump expressed sympathy for the family of Lindsay Clancy’s three children while signaling that he would not intervene in the former nurse’s state murder case.

title: Trump tells Zelenskyy to stop doing 'one thing' during attacks on Russia
summary: President Donald Trump told reporters he wants Volodymyr Zelensky to stop hitting Russian diesel refineries, saying the strikes are causing a global fuel shortage.

title: Trump gives Smithsonian days to replace 'strange modernist sculpture' with Founding Father
summary: President Donald Trump demands a 30-foot George Washington statue replace the "Infinity" sculpture outside the National Museum of American History in Washington.

title: Vulnerable House Republicans embrace Trump as GOP bets on defying midterm history
summary: President Donald Trump urged Republicans to "pretend that I'm on the ballot," as vulnerable GOP incumbents rallied at the first-ever midterm convention.

title: GOP rising star reveals how Republicans can lock down minority voters without Trump on ballot
summary: T.W. Shannon says Donald Trump transformed the GOP into a working party, pointing to job creation and lower crime as keys to winning Black voters.

title: Trump says he would 'love' to see Ireland unified as one nation
summary: Speaking to reporters, President Donald Trump said he hopes to see Ireland become one country in the future, predicting reunification will happen over time.
